answer_text:
I could not find any public post (on X or the web) containing that exact sentence.

I searched:

Exact phrase matches for “the two platforms shared only 2 of 20 unique recommended entities — about 10% overlap.”
Close variants (“2 of 20 unique recommended entities,” “unique recommended entities” + overlap, “platforms shared only 2 of 20,” “10% overlap” with recommended/entities, etc.).
Keyword and semantic searches on X.
Broader web searches for related concepts (platform overlap of recommended entities/items).

None returned a matching post, article, or source. No X post with that wording (or a near-identical version) appeared in results.

Possible reasons it is not surfacing:

The post is very recent and not yet indexed.
It was deleted, set to private, or from a protected account.
Minor wording/punctuation differences (e.g., hyphen vs. em dash, “approx.” instead of “about,” slight rephrasing).
It originated elsewhere (newsletter, private chat, non-public document) and was only partially quoted.

If you have additional context (author name, approximate date, platform names involved, surrounding text, or a screenshot/link fragment), I can search more specifically.
